description: This file defines a data contract class 'Report' and an interface 'ILoadGrain' for a grain in an Orleans-based distributed system, related to transaction load testing.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: A data class used to report transaction success, failure, throttling, and elapsed time.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Initiates a transaction load generation with specified parameters.

methods.name: TryGetReport
methods.description: Retrieves the current report of transaction results.
